comment: Recognition layer 2: community/district signs. Shown as a highway-style green sign when the car enters each community. Coordinates are real lat/lon projected into world space at runtime (same pipeline as landmarks.json). radius = trigger distance in compressed-world meters. Uncertain placements are flagged needs_owner_review: true — the owner's lived knowledge is authoritative over map data.

communities.name: Palisadoes
communities.note: The narrow strip of land between the airport and Kingston — sea on both sides

communities.name: Harbour View
communities.note: Roundabout gateway from the Palisadoes into Kingston proper

communities.name: Rock Fort
